description: Descriptive characterization of how the configured FLY-SURFER network moves from localized sensory current injection into population-scale activity, and which measurable properties separate bounded sparse discharge from the P3-T2 C3 regime.

protocol.question: How does the configured network move from localized sensory current injection into population-scale activity, and which measurable properties separate bounded sparse discharge from the P3-T2 C3 regime?

C0.description: no external current; same graph, duration, timestep, seed and initial state. input_schedule is None.

C1.description: 100 neutral TemporalFrames at 30 fps with GameState.neutral(); only the four player-default features are active. No object detections and no object-derived features.

C2.description: the same cached visual frames as C3 with every player-default feature disabled; hold and visual event pulses restricted to the ten non-player features. Not pulses-only.

C3.description: full sensory replay of the cached visual frames with all fourteen features active; must reproduce the archived Phase 3B.2C scheduler signature and spike-count hash.

no-player_lane.description: full input with 'player_lane' removed; 13 features active

no-train_lane.description: full input with 'train_lane' removed; 13 features active

C3-washout.description: archived C3 schedule run 750 ms past the validated window; the last 500.5 ms cannot receive scheduled drive

smoke.note: C3 compared against the archived P3-T2 reference

classification.criterion: provisional relational criterion: outside-R active neurons exceed the size of the entire fixed reference set R AND the outside-R firing rate is at least the reference-partition firing rate. No preregistered absolute threshold exists, so this label is provisional, not a preregistered definition.

limitations: Spikes are model output under configured assumptions (assumed LIF parameters, sign-by-transmitter policy, transformed structural synapse counts), not measured biological activity.
Outside A_c means not eligible for direct current injection; it is not proof that a spike was caused synaptically.
Hop distance is structural graph distance, not axonal length, conduction delay or spatial position. The graph has no coordinates.
Membrane sampling every 10 ms summarises 139,255 neurons per sample; exact per-neuron traces are not retained.
The washout extension lies outside the validated 3,300.5 ms window; the prefix gate only proves that its first 3,300.5 ms equal C3.
No action is selected and no claim is made about perception, learning, decisions, information routing or behaviour.
action_selection: none; the chain ends at sensory current injection
